title: England and Wales population estimates
description: ONS mid-year population estimates for England and Wales, with the detailed annual back series by local authority from 2011 and the long historical series from 1838. Released ahead of the UK-wide equivalent in the sibling 'uk' dataset, so it carries a later reference year.
